description: The location Lionscope put on a device (set_location or the dashboard's Location panel), or null, and for an emulator also its current GPS fix. method 'emulator' is the emulator's own GPS (apps see a real fix); 'mock_provider' is a physical device's mock location (apps see Location.isMock() true). A physical device's real location is never read.

serial.description: adb serial; default: the session device, or the only ready one.

name: get_location
title: Device location
